_doc: Per-project nightly config for swarm/nightly.mjs. Keys MUST be project ids from ../projects/registry.json — nightly.mjs refuses to run anything unregistered. 'local' is the checkout the worker clones (leading ~ and $HOME are expanded; paths are per-machine). 'setup' steps run before the tests (e.g. dependency install). 'test' is the command under test. Binaries are resolved via PATH at submit time and the plan carries absolute paths, so workers never depend on the daemon's environment. Optional 'release': {command, args} declares the repo's real release command for CAP_RELEASE-gated release workers (project.release) — leave it out until the project has a real one.
